coverLetter:
Maya Linden
Portland, OR, USA
maya.linden@example.com
+1 555 0142

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Elastic

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your ad says Elastic's biggest growth is inside its existing customer base, which means the job is keeping those customers hearing from you in a way that matters. I've worked on a small version of that problem. At Harbor Street Pet Supply, I grew the newsletter list from 640 to 1,150 subscribers over one summer, then wrote the weekly newsletter for the people who had signed up.

I'm early in my career, so I won't claim B2B software experience I don't have. What I do have is hands-on email work in Mailchimp, copywriting, and a habit of checking numbers. As Social Media Lead for the Westbrook Film Society, I raised average ticket sales from 35 to 60 per event with a weekly reel, and I kept it going because the results told me it worked. I've studied Google Analytics (Google Analytics for Beginners, 2024) and use Excel and Instagram Insights to see what performed. That's the bias towards execution and the "fail fast, get things done" attitude you describe, and I'm keen to apply it to campaign reporting and proactive optimization across the customer lifecycle. I'm also eager to learn how AI-assisted workflows can speed up that work.

I'd welcome a conversation about how I can support the Customer Marketing team as a Demand Generation Coordinator. I'm available to start a call at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Maya Linden
